description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用多元教學活動，協助學生運用語言學習策略，討論教材之議題，以達成以下目標：培養基礎英文書寫能力，深化英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的技能，並學習理解他人觀點及感受。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels and uses a variety of teaching activities to help students apply language learning strategies, and discuss topics from their course materials in order to achieve the following learning objectives: develop basic English writing skills, deepen their English reading, speaking, and listening skills, and learn to understand the different viewpoints and feelings of others..

targets.describe_ch: 運用所學之學習策略，針對教材內容，有效地以外語表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通。
targets.describe_en: Students can apply learning strategies to effectively convey their opinions regarding the themes presented in learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
1. Be on time. Any entry to the classroom after attendance check in the beginning of the class will be marked absence, unless you have
legitimate and special reason according to the school rules. Taking too many leaves will also affect your score for course participation. If you are
absent (including both excused and unexcused leaves) over 12 hours (including 12 hours), missing either midterm or final evaluation, you will
fail the course. 請準時上課。點名後才進教室者該節將以曠課論,除非是因校規規定之重大事故遲到。請假過多也會影響平時成
績。缺課次數(含請假及曠課)12節以上(含12節),期中考、期末考有缺一個以上,學期總成績一律以不及格論。
2. Participate in the class discussion and class activities. 請參與課堂討論及課堂活動。
3. Students must submit a leave application to the school in advance, stating the reason for the leave and the expected duration. 如需請假,學
生必須提前向學校提交請假申請,說明請假的原因和預計時間。
4. Please purchase original textbook, following intellectual property law. 請購買正版課本,請勿使用複製版本。
5. The texts and exercises will be completed in class. Please bring textbooks to class. 請上課攜帶課本,以利上課活動使用。
6. Follow the school rules to apply for a make-up exam within three days of the quiz date. Relevant documents are required for the application.
No-shows or those with late application will receive ZERO. The date of a make-up exam will be arranged by the instructor. You are only
allowed to apply for a make-up quiz at most 2 times in a semester. Only those who have taken leave on the system can apply. Missing quiz due
to late entry to the classroom or unexcused absence won't be accepted for make-up quiz. 若須要補考小考的同學,請遵照學校的補考規
定,在考試後的3天內提出申請。若考試當天沒有出現或者是沒有申請補考的同學,考試成績一律0分。小考一學期至多能申請
兩次補考,有於系統請假者才可以申請。遲到、曠課一律不接受補考。
7. No allowance for make-up midterm exam and final presentation, unless you have got legitimate and special reason according to the school
rules and: 期中考和期末考一律不接受補考和補報告,除非為特殊原因或重大事故並:
(1) Notify the course instructor before the evaluation date 於考試日期前事先告知授課教師
(2) Need approval from the course instructor in advance 經授課教師事先同意
(3) Present relevant and official evidence 提出相關正式證明文件
(4) If something emergent happened, please notify within three days of the exam/evaluation and present relevant and official documents. 如重大
事件事發臨時,最晚在考試時間開始三日內告知,並提出相關正式證明文件
8. Following the FCU Exam Regulations, cheaters will receive ZERO for their exams and such cases will be reviewed by the Student Reward
and Disciplinary Committee. 考試請遵照考場規定,若作弊者以0分計算。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno:
1.Students must exhibit honesty and ethical behavior in their academic activities, avoiding plagiarism and falsification of data.學生在學術活
動中必須展現誠實和道德行為,避免抄襲和篡改資料。
2.Plagiarism: Proper citation of sources is required. Copying or using others' work without appropriate attribution is considered plagiarism.抄
襲:必須適當引用來源。未經適當標示使用他人作品屬於抄襲行為。
3.Cheating: Following exam rules is mandatory. Unauthorized materials or collusion with others during exams is considered cheating.考試作
弊:必須遵守考試規則,禁止使用未經授權的材料或與他人串通作弊。
